One negative data point does not constitute a trend or a crisis. 4) The statement 'Financial leverage increased from 1.83 to 2.05' is factually incorrect. The data shows leverage was 1.83 in Q1 2015, fluctuated, and was 1.93 in Q2 2016. The 2.05 value appeared in Q4 2015 and Q1 2016, but the final datapoint shows an improvement to 1.93.
